themes: Memory price inflation and supply chain volatility compress margins; passed through pricing; expects normalization

Component backward integration (display, camera modules, SSD) to drive absolute profit growth and margin restoration
Strategic partnerships (Inventec, Gemtek, Vivo JV) expand into servers, data centers, optical transceivers; tech capability building
Market share gains despite 10-12% smartphone market contraction; strong order book visibility for next quarters
Home appliances and lighting portfolio expansion; premium positioning; export opportunities in developed markets
risks: Memory price volatility and supply chain inflation create ongoing margin pressure; PLI 2 execution risk if guidelines delay
Component ramp-up delays or lower-than-expected contribution from display and camera modules in near term
Global demand headwinds: smartphone volumes declined 10-12% globally; appliance seasonality affected by less intense summer and unseasonal rains
Q Tech currency headwinds and slower-than-expected margin recovery; Vivo JV approval and operational timelines

analyst_pushback.question: Is PLI 2 applicable only to exports or domestic volumes too?
analyst_pushback.response: Incremental production over base year (FY26 brand-wise) eligible irrespective of exports; growth expected from exports

analyst_pushback.question: Can PLI 2 and localization alone make India cost-competitive vs China?
analyst_pushback.response: PLI 2 is well-curated; we can now stand on our own feet; positive traction from two anchor customers

analyst_pushback.question: When will margins improve given memory price and input cost pressures?
analyst_pushback.response: Components contribute next fiscal; memory prices likely remain elevated; margin improvement expected FY28

analyst_pushback.question: Why is Q Tech margin contribution subdued vs pre-acquisition 6-8% EBITDA?
analyst_pushback.response: Q Tech adding margins but ramping slowly; FX was headwind; gradually improving as capacity and manufacturing deepen

tone_evidence: Confident on growth initiatives, strategic partnerships, market share gains; cautious on near-term margins and component ramp timelines
